tree.name: The Web Foundation & Core Technologies
tree.description: Master the foundational building blocks of the web platform: browser rendering mechanics, semantic markup, responsive design systems, modern CSS layout engines, and deep browser developer tools diagnostics.

children.name: How the Internet & Web Works
children.description: Understand the Critical Rendering Path: how browsers transform raw HTML bytes into DOM and CSSOM trees, construct the Render Tree, compute Layout (Reflow), and Paint onto Composited GPU layers. Deep dive into HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 multiplexing and HTTP/3 (QUIC), DNS prefetching, preconnecting, and TLS handshake latency impact on web performance.

resources.title: How the Internet Works: A Deep Dive
How the Internet Works in 5 Minutes (Aaron)

children.name: HTML5: Structure, Semantics & Accessibility
children.description: Engineer accessible and semantic web applications. Master landmark elements (<main>, <nav>, <article>, <aside>, <dialog>), WAI-ARIA roles, states, and properties (aria-expanded, aria-live, aria-describedby), keyboard focus navigation (focus trapping in modals, visible focus indicators, roving tabindex), screen reader accessibility, and meeting WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliance.

resources.title: Structuring Content with HTML (MDN Web Docs)
Learn HTML5 and CSS3 From Scratch - Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: CSS3: Styling & Core Concepts
children.description: Master modern CSS architecture and the cascade. Understand specificity calculation, the :where() zero-specificity pseudo-class, dynamic theming using CSS Custom Properties (variables), modern math functions (clamp(), min(), max()), and Cascade Layers (@layer) for organizing design system precedence and avoiding specificity wars.

children.name: CSS Layouts & Responsive Design
children.description: Build resilient, responsive layout systems. Master Flexbox alignment and sizing mechanics (flex-grow, flex-shrink, flex-basis) and CSS Grid (auto-fit, minmax(), subgrid for aligned card hierarchies). Leverage modern Container Queries (@container) for true component-driven responsiveness independent of viewport dimensions, and the View Transitions API for fluid page transitions.

resources.title: Introduction To Responsive Web Design - HTML & CSS Tutorial (freeCodeCamp.org)
Learn CSS Grid the easy way (Kevin Powell)

children.name: Introduction to Browser Developer Tools
children.description: Master advanced browser profiling using Chrome DevTools. Analyze performance flame charts to detect Long Tasks (>50ms) and main-thread jank, identify memory leaks and detached DOM nodes in the Heap Snapshot panel, evaluate network waterfalls (TTFB vs download), and audit Core Web Vitals using the Performance Insights panel.

resources.title: Google Chrome Developer Tools Crash Course (Traversy Media)
Google Chrome Developer Tools Crash Course (Traversy Media)

tree.name: Core JavaScript & DOM Interaction
tree.description: Attain deep proficiency in the JavaScript language, V8 engine execution internals, asynchronous control flow, DOM event propagation, and modern modular software architecture.

children.name: JavaScript Fundamentals & ES6+
children.description: Master modern JavaScript (ES2024+) and runtime execution. Understand V8 engine internals (JIT compilation, hidden classes, inline caches), execution contexts, closures and their memory impact, prototypal inheritance vs class syntax, and modern features (optional chaining, nullish coalescing, structuredClone, private class fields).

resources.title: The Complete JavaScript Course 2024: From Zero to Expert! (Jonas Schmedtmann)
JavaScript Programming - Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: DOM Manipulation & Event Handling
children.description: Master high-performance DOM manipulation and event architecture. Deep dive into event propagation phases (Capturing, Target, Bubbling), event delegation for dynamic lists, passive event listeners for smooth scrolling, MutationObserver for DOM mutations, and IntersectionObserver / ResizeObserver for performant lazy loading and element dimension tracking without layout thrashing.

resources.title: JavaScript DOM Crash Course - Part 1 (Traversy Media)
JavaScript DOM Crash Course - Part 1 (Traversy Media)

children.name: Asynchronous JavaScript, JSON & APIs
children.description: Master asynchronous JavaScript. Understand the browser event loop: Microtask queue (Promises, queueMicrotask) vs Macrotask queue (setTimeout, I/O, UI rendering). Master Promise combinators (Promise.all, Promise.allSettled, Promise.race, Promise.any), streaming responses with Fetch API, and using AbortController to cancel in-flight requests and prevent race conditions.

resources.title: Asynchronous JavaScript and Event Loop (Akshay Saini)
The Async Await Episode I Promised (Fireship)

children.name: JavaScript Modules & Classes
children.description: Architect clean JavaScript code using ES Modules (ESM). Compare static imports with dynamic import() for code-splitting, manage circular dependency hazards, understand tree-shaking mechanics (sideEffects in package.json), and implement modular design patterns (Observer, Factory, Singleton) for clean client-side architecture.

resources.title: JavaScript OOP Crash Course (ES5 & ES6) (Traversy Media)

tree.name: Version Control & Package Management
tree.description: Master enterprise developer workflows: version control collaboration, git hygiene, package management, dependency security, and automated repository governance.

children.name: Git & GitHub Fundamentals
children.description: Master professional Git practices. Execute trunk-based development, semantic commit conventions, interactive rebasing (git rebase -i), resolving complex merge conflicts, understanding Git internals (blobs, trees, commits, refs), and managing pull request code reviews.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
How to create a pull request in 4 min | GitHub for Beginners (GitHub)

children.name: npm/Yarn: Package Managers
children.description: Master frontend dependency management with npm, pnpm, and yarn. Understand lockfile determinism, semantic versioning (^, ~, exact), peerDependencies resolution, monorepo workspaces, auditing vulnerabilities (npm audit), and pruning unused dependencies to prevent supply chain attacks.

tree.name: Modern Frontend Framework: React.js
tree.description: Master the React ecosystem: component architecture, custom hook composition, state management paradigms, form validations, routing, and modern rendering optimizations.

children.name: React Introduction, JSX & Components
children.description: Master React 19 component architecture. Understand JSX compilation, the React Fiber reconciler (work loops, time slicing, prioritizing user interactions), unidirectional data flow, component composition over inheritance, and writing pure, side-effect-free components.

resources.title: React Tutorial for Beginners (Programming with Mosh)

children.name: State Management with Hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext)
children.description: Master state management and hook composition in React. Understand state immutability, batched re-renders, and React 19 hooks (useActionState, useOptimistic, use). Master custom hook creation, avoiding stale closures in useEffect, replacing useEffect with derived state calculations, and properly cleaning up event listeners and timers.

resources.title: React Hooks - Полный Курс (Про Все Хуки в 1 видео!) (Владилен Минин)

resources.title: React CSS Showdown 2025: CSS Modules vs. Sass vs. Styled Components vs. Tailwind CSS (MaksDevInsights)

Learn React 18 with Redux Toolkit – Full Tutorial for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

resources.title: How To Maximize Performance In Your React Apps (Web Dev Simplified)

children.name: Module Bundlers (Webpack/Vite) & Transpilers (Babel)
children.description: Master frontend build tooling: Vite (powered by esbuild and Rollup) and Webpack. Understand Hot Module Replacement (HMR), production chunk splitting strategies, tree-shaking, asset hashing for immutable CDN caching, and generating source maps securely.

Vite Crash Course | Faster Alternative To CRA (Traversy Media)
